media_catalog.chapter_title: How I Taught My Grandmother to Read & Bharat Our Land

hotspots.label: Phase 1: Helplessness & Dependence
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Krishtakka depended entirely on her 12-year-old granddaughter to read the weekly serialized novel Kashi Yatre from Karmaveera magazine.

hotspots.label: Phase 3: The Catalyst & Vow
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: During her granddaughter's 1-week absence, Krishtakka felt crushingly helpless unable to read, vowing to learn the Kannada alphabet by Saraswati Pooja.

hotspots.label: Phase 5: Triumph & Self-Reliance
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: On Dussehra, 62-year-old Krishtakka fluently read Kashi Yatre independently and touched her granddaughter's feet in reverence as her Guru.

video_overview.title: Teaching Grandma to Read
video_overview.topics_covered: Krishtakka's determination to learn the Kannada alphabet at age 62, the transformative power of literacy, and the Guru-Shishya tradition.

media_catalog.chapter_title: The Pot Maker & Gifts of Grace: Honouring Our Vocations

hotspots.label: Wedging & Kneading
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Thoroughly kneading moist river clay to remove trapped air bubbles, preventing structural cracking during high-temperature firing.

hotspots.label: Hand Molding & Shaping
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Sentila practiced secretly behind her home to shape smooth, balanced clay pots using traditional hand-molding techniques.

hotspots.label: Open Kiln Firing
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Firing dried clay vessels in open village kilns to permanently harden earth into durable ceramic pots.

video_overview.title: The Pot Maker
video_overview.topics_covered: Sentila's secret practice and mastery of traditional Naga pottery, parental protectiveness versus artistic vocation, and community heritage.

media_catalog.chapter_title: Winds of Change & Canvas of Soil

image_asset.title: Anatomy of a Woven Palm-Leaf Pankha

hotspots.label: Interwoven Fronds & Craftsmanship
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Woven plant fronds adorned with regional embroidery, mica work, and beads, creating an eco-friendly zero-carbon cooling fan.

hotspots.label: Central Bamboo Handle
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Sturdy bamboo spine distributing structural tension across the woven fronds for easy hand-held operation.

video_overview.title: Winds of Change - The World of Pankhas
video_overview.topics_covered: Traditional Indian hand-fans (pankhas), zero-carbon climate adaptation, folk craftsmanship, and nature poetry.

media_catalog.chapter_title: Vitamin-M & I Cannot Remember My Mother

hotspots.label: Auditory Branch: Lullaby Tune
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: An old humming lullaby floating over playthings recalls the mother's presence during early childhood play.

hotspots.label: Olfactory Branch: Shiuli Fragrance
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: The sweet scent of autumn Shiuli blossoms evokes memories of the mother gathering flowers for morning temple worship.

hotspots.label: Visual Branch: Blue Sky
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: The serene expanse of the blue sky viewed from the bedroom window conveys the mother's silent, all-encompassing gaze.

video_overview.title: Vitamin-M & Senility
video_overview.topics_covered: Elderly autonomy, intergenerational caregiving, Ravi shadowing his grandfather, and Tagore's sensory memory poetry.

media_catalog.chapter_title: The World of Limitless Possibilities & Nine Gold Medals

hotspots.label: Dr. Deepa Malik Milestones
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: First Indian woman Paralympic medalist (Rio 2016 Silver in Shot Put F53), demonstrating that ability resides in mental fortitude.

hotspots.label: Nine Gold Medals Solidarity
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Special Olympics runners stopping to lift a fallen competitor and walking across the finish line hand-in-hand.

video_overview.title: Limitless Possibilities
video_overview.topics_covered: Dr. Deepa Malik's Paralympic journey, adaptive sports, overcoming physical adversity, and David Roth's poem on Special Olympics empathy.

media_catalog.chapter_title: Twin Melodies & A Friend Found in Music

hotspots.label: Mother's Key Revelation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Mother reveals Nabin defied his own father's vocal tradition in his youth to play the violin, creating dramatic irony.

hotspots.label: Stage Reconciliation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Nabin attends Shruti's concert, embraces her Indo-Western fusion music, and proudly reconciles with his daughter.

video_overview.title: Twin Melodies
video_overview.topics_covered: Shruti's fusion violin band, classical music purism vs innovation, dramatic irony, and intergenerational family acceptance.

image_asset.title: Rural Postal Logistics in Thar Desert

hotspots.label: GDS Last-Mile Trail
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Khetaram traversing harsh desert dunes on foot or bicycle to deliver mail, pensions, and read/write letters for illiterate villagers.

video_overview.title: The Lone Desert Postman
video_overview.topics_covered: Gramin Dak Sewak Khetaram's daily duties, Thar Desert logistics, rural postal lifelines, and human connection.

media_catalog.chapter_title: Follow That Dream & Believe in Yourself

hotspots.label: Base: Self-Belief & Daily Discipline
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Daily discipline and growth mindset forming the indispensable foundation for long-term goal realization.

video_overview.title: Follow That Dream
video_overview.topics_covered: Epistolary mother-daughter guidance, Fixed vs Growth Mindsets, perseverance through setbacks, and SMART goal setting.
